description.value: Lucy's Eastside Diner is a 24/7 American diner on Main Street in Vancouver's east side, making it one of the few sit-down spots available to cyclists at any hour of the day or night. The diner offers online ordering, suggesting a takeout option alongside its dine-in service. Its location on Main Street — a heavily cycled corridor in Vancouver — places it squarely in the path of touring and commuter cyclists.
